# Flying Colors Science

> A comprehensive middle school science education platform offering NGSS-aligned curriculum, worksheets, and teaching resources across Earth science, physical science, and STEM topics.

Flying Colors Science, created by Lisa Meschutt, provides teachers with ready-to-use lesson plans, assessments, and classroom activities designed specifically for middle school science instruction. The site features both free blog content and premium products organized by topic and standards alignment.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Middle School Science
- Earth Science
- Physical Science
- Science Curriculum
- Plate Tectonics
- Earth's Layers
- Climate Change
- Energy & Transformations
- Electricity & Magnetism
- CER Activity (Claims-Evidence-Reasoning)
- Science Worksheets
- Teaching Resources
- STEM Learning
- Science Assessments

## Shop & Products

- [Shop - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/shop): Shop for educational science products, worksheets, and STEM learning materials
- [Complete Set of Middle School Science Notes](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/physical-science): Comprehensive middle school science curriculum bundles and full-year resource sets

## Earth & Space Science

- [All Earth and Space Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space): Earth and space science product catalog with NGSS-aligned lessons and activities
- [Plate Tectonics Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/plate-tectonics): Plate tectonics, continental drift, and seafloor spreading (NGSS MS-ESS2-1/2)
- [Earth's Layers Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/earths-layers): Earth's layers curriculum covering crust, mantle, and core for middle school
- [Earth's Changing Surface Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/earths-changing-surface): Middle school Earth science on weathering, erosion, and rock cycle (MS-ESS2-1/2)
- [Climate Change Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/climate-change): Climate change lessons addressing NGSS MS-ESS3-4 and MS-ESS3-5 standards
- [Weather Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/weather): Weather maps, fronts, and atmospheric circulation for NGSS MS-ESS2-5
- [Water Cycle Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/water-cycle): Water cycle and precipitation activities for NGSS MS-ESS2-4
- [Moon & Tides Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/moon-tides): Moon phases, eclipses, and tides activities for NGSS MS-ESS1-1/2
- [Seasons Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/seasons): Earth's motions and axial tilt causing seasons for NGSS MS-ESS1-1
- [Earth's History Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/earths-history): Earth history, fossils, and superposition activities for NGSS MS-ESS1-4
- [Natural Resources Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/natural-resources): Natural resources distribution and fossil fuels for NGSS MS-ESS3-1
- [Human Impact on Earth Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/earth-and-space/human-impact-on-earth): Human impact and environmental solutions for middle school Earth science

## Physical Science

- [All Physical Science Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/physical-science): Physical science product catalog with chemistry and physics lessons
- [Energy Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/physical-science/energy): Energy transformations and claims-evidence activities for middle school
- [Electricity & Magnetism Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/physical-science/electricity-magnetism): Electricity and magnetism activities and worksheets for middle school
- [Classifying Matter Archives - Flying Colors Science](https://flyingcolorsscience.com/product-category/physical-science/classifying-matter): Matter classification and atoms curriculum for middle school chemistry
